patent.title: Compositions and methods for modulating HBV and TTR expression
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-10. MFDS Green List lists 10-2212275 on Wainua. Do not conflate with sibling 10-2712053 on same product.

knowledge_origin.description: Ionis Pharmaceuticals assignee; antisense oligomer RD.

technology.problem: Modulate HBV and transthyretin (TTR) expression with conjugated oligomer therapeutics.
technology.mechanism: Oligomer compounds conjugated to N-acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) for targeted modulation of HBV/TTR expression.
technology.comparison_baseline: Unconjugated antisense / prior oligomer delivery (patent background).

value_carriers.name: Wainua® (eplontersen sodium) 45 mg autoinjector
value_carriers.description: MFDS Green List lists 10-2212275 on Wainua. API eplontersen = GalNAc-conjugated ASO targeting TTR — matches claim class. Sibling 10-2712053 also listed.
